label: S.J.Res. 88
title: A joint resolution terminating the national emergency declared to impose global tariffs.
summary: This joint resolution terminates the national emergency declared by President Donald J. Trump on April 2, 2025, which imposed a 10% tariff on most imports to the United States and additional duties on specified trading partners.
summary_short: This joint resolution terminates the national emergency declared by President Donald J.
